name: A Puppet with No Reflection

source.note: One of Blinsky's toys (easter-egg plan R3); ours.

summary: A pale wooden puppet with silver-white hair and a red-lined coat, posed before a little toy mirror.
text: Gadof Blinsky's work: an elegant pale puppet admiring himself in a thumb-sized looking glass. Turn him how you like; the glass shows only whatever stands behind him. Nobody in Vallaki has ever wanted one.
